Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscompared the directors’ birth dates. Despite correctly finding that Jorge Brum do Canto was born in 1910 and Monte Hellman in 1929, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Hellman was born earlier, citing “smaller age indicates an earlier birth,” which is the reverse of correct logic. This led to the wrong final answer (choosing The Shooting instead of Retalhos Da Vida De Um Médico).
